alex: Heads up — new EU Data Access policy went live today. Mandatory compliance module + 20-min quiz. Managers: please confirm your direct reports complete it by 2026-04-06. RSVP/track here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE (please don't edit other tabs)

people-ops-bot: Reminder: training due in 14 days for employees in EU regions. Auto-notice to non-compliant on 2026-04-07.

maria: Quick Q — does this apply to contractors on short SOWs? @alex

alex: @maria Good Q. Short-term contractors (<=30 days) are exempt for now — mark 'contractor-exempt' column. For >30 days, they must take it.

jamal: Can managers complete on behalf of engineers if they're on leave? e.g., maternity/paternity

katie: No — must be individual. If someone's on approved leave, flag them in the sheet and we'll track separately.

anne: Done for my team. I added completion dates + quiz scores. :white_check_mark:

alex: Thanks @anne. If you hit a row with 'follow-up' status, please ping me directly and we'll escalate.

alex: Manager checklist (paste into sheet or copy into your tracker):
```
manager,team_size,completed_count,pending_count,follow_up,notes
anne,8,8,0,no,"all completed"
```

training-bot: Auto: new row added to tracking sheet by alex. ID: 2468. (system notification)

katie: We're running two live Q&A office hours: 2026-03-29 11:00 UTC and 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC. Link: https://meet.example.com/eu-policy-qa

jamal: If managers need a bulk export for people who didn't complete, can we get a CSV?

alex: Yes — export available in sheet (File -> Download -> CSV). I'll also post a list next Wednesday.

maria: Will there be localized translations? We have a DE-only team.

alex: Short-term: English only. If >5 people request a translation, we'll prioritize.

people-ops-bot: Digest: 6 teams completed, 4 teams pending, 12 people in follow-up. Reminder scheduled for 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC.

alex: I'll follow up with managers of pending teams next week. Thanks everyone. If you haven't filled the sheet, please do it by EOD Monday.
